description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing user-related administrative actions, including listing users, viewing user details, updating user roles, and discarding users within the Coocook application.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::User
classes.description: Controller class for administrative user management in the Coocook application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to list all users with their project counts and status descriptions.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a user by name and prepares the user object and role permissions for further actions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific user, including roles, permissions, organization memberships, and project access.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update user details, including admin comments and roles.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Handles POST requests to discard (delete) a user, with optional blacklisting.
